vehicle.notes: UK RHD. Toyota LH/RH = vehicle's own left/right (LH = UK nearside/passenger side, RH = UK offside/driver side). European C-HRs were built in Turkey; US-market (Japan-built) numbers seen in searches were excluded. Facelift late 2019 (listings variously say 2019-, 2020- or 2021-). Some listings show Toyota's 12-character form with a '-00' suffix (e.g. 81110-F4051-00). Numbers were read from web-search results (titles/summaries) of the cited UK eBay pages; page fetches were blocked and the shared web-search budget ran out early, so only headlamps and front bumpers are covered. Verify by VIN.
